source_title: Diwali bonanza for central govt employees as Cabinet approves 3% DA hike - India Today
source_excerpt:
Cabinet approves 3% dearness allowance hike for central government employees ahead of festive season.
The Union Cabinet has approved a 3% hike in dearness allowance (DA) for central government employees and a corresponding increase in dearness relief (DR) for pensioners.
The decision will raise DA and DR from 60% to 63% of basic pay and pension, respectively. The hike will have a financial implication of Rs 10,016 crore.
The increase comes ahead of Diwali and is intended to help government employees and pensioners offset the impact of rising prices. While DA is paid to serving central government employees, DR is provided to pensioners.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the decision after the Cabinet meeting on Wednesday, October 28. He called the DA hike a Diwali gift from the Prime Minister to 48 lakh central government employees and 68 lakh pensioners.
The latest revision raises DA by three percentage points, from the existing 60% of basic pay to 63%. The corresponding increase in DR will take the relief rate for pensioners from 60% to 63% of their eligible basic pension.
DA is calculated as a percentage of basic pay and revised periodically to account for changes in the cost of living. The increase in the allowance raises an employee’s monthly pay, with the actual benefit depending on their basic salary.
For instance, a central government employee with a basic pay of Rs 18,000 will receive an additional Rs 540 per month following the three-percentage-point increase. An employee with a basic pay of Rs 35,400 will get an additional Rs 1,062 per month.
Pensioners will receive a corresponding increase in their monthly dearness relief, calculated on their eligible basic pension. PREVIOUS HIKE WAS ANNOUNCED IN APRIL
The latest decision follows the previous revision announced in April 2026, when the government raised DA and DR by two percentage points, from 58% to 60%, with effect from January 1, 2026.
The government generally revises DA and DR twice a year, with instalments effective from January 1 and July 1. The latest increase relates to the July 2026 instalment.
Since the revision is linked to the July instalment, eligible employees and pensioners will also be entitled to arrears from the applicable effective date, subject to the terms of the government order.
The combined financial implication of Rs 10,016 crore reflects the cost of the DA and DR revision for the government. HOW DA HIKE AFFECTS TAKE-HOME SALARY
The three-percentage-point increase does not mean a 3% rise in an employee’s entire salary. DA is calculated on basic pay, which means the additional amount varies according to an employee’s pay level.
For an employee drawing a basic salary of Rs 18,000, the monthly DA will rise from Rs 10,800 at the existing 60% rate to Rs 11,340 at 63%, an increase of Rs 540.
For someone with a basic salary of Rs 50,000, monthly DA will rise from Rs 30,000 to Rs 31,500, an increase of Rs 1,500.
The corresponding increase for pensioners will depend on their eligible basic pension. The revised DA and DR rates will apply under the terms and effective date specified in the government’s order. - Ends
hi_body:
केंद्रीय मंत्री अश्विनी वैष्णव ने घोषणा की है कि केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने केंद्रीय सरकार के कर्मचारियों के लिए महंगाई भत्ते (DA) और पेंशनभोगियों के लिए महंगाई राहत (DR) में 3 प्रतिशत की बढ़ोतरी को मंजूरी दे दी है। इस संशोधन के बाद डीए और डीआर मूल वेतन और पेंशन के 60% से बढ़कर 63% हो जाएंगे।

यह निर्णय बुधवार, 28 अक्टूबर को कैबिनेट की बैठक के बाद दीवाली के त्योहारी सीजन से ठीक पहले घोषित किया गया। आधिकारिक घोषणा के अनुसार, इस कदम का उद्देश्य लगभग 48 लाख केंद्रीय कर्मचारियों और 68 लाख पेंशनभोगियों को बढ़ती कीमतों के प्रभाव से राहत दिलाना है।

## वित्तीय प्रभाव और गणना

सरकार के लिए इस संशोधन का कुल वित्तीय प्रभाव 10,016 करोड़ रुपये आंका गया है। यह बढ़ोतरी जुलाई 2026 की किस्त से संबंधित है, और पात्र कर्मचारियों तथा पेंशनभोगियों को सरकारी आदेश के नियमों के अनुसार प्रभावी तिथि से एरियर भी मिलने की संभावना है।

- **मूल वेतन पर प्रभाव:** 3% की यह वृद्धि पूरे वेतन पर नहीं, बल्कि केवल मूल वेतन या मूल पेंशन पर लागू होती है।
- **18,000 रुपये मूल वेतन का उदाहरण:** इस श्रेणी के कर्मचारियों का मासिक डीए 10,800 रुपये से बढ़कर 11,340 रुपये यानी 540 रुपये अधिक हो जाएगा।
- **35,400 रुपये मूल वेतन का उदाहरण:** ऐसे कर्मचारियों को प्रति माह 1,062 रुपये की अतिरिक्त राशि मिलेगी।
- **50,000 रुपये मूल वेतन का उदाहरण:** मासिक भत्ता 30,000 रुपये से बढ़कर 31,500 रुपये यानी 1,500 रुपये अधिक हो जाएगा।

## पृष्ठभूमि और सत्यापन

केंद्रीय सरकार आमतौर पर साल में दो बार डीए और डीआर में संशोधन करती है, जो 1 जनवरी और 1 जुलाई से प्रभावी होते हैं। यह ताजा निर्णय अप्रैल 2026 में की गई पिछली संशोधन के बाद आया है, जिसमें दरें 58% से बढ़ाकर 60% की गई थीं।

कार्यान्वयन और वास्तविक लाभ से जुड़े विवरण की पुष्टि के लिए वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी होने वाले आधिकारिक आदेशों और अधिसूचनाओं का संदर्भ लें।

en_body:
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that the Union Cabinet has approved a 3-percentage-point hike in dearness allowance (DA) for central government employees and dearness relief (DR) for pensioners, raising the rate from 60% to 63% of basic pay and pension.

The decision was announced following a Cabinet meeting on Wednesday, October 28, ahead of the Diwali festival. According to the official announcement, the revision is intended to benefit approximately 48 lakh central government employees and 68 lakh pensioners by helping offset rising living costs.

## Financial Implications and Calculation

The combined financial implication of this latest revision is reported at Rs 10,016 crore. This adjustment relates to the July 2026 instalment, and eligible recipients are expected to receive arrears from the applicable effective date as outlined in forthcoming government orders.

- **Basic Pay Impact:** The 3% increase applies strictly to basic pay or pension, not the total salary.
- **Example for Rs 18,000 Basic:** Monthly DA will increase by Rs 540, moving from Rs 10,800 to Rs 11,340.
- **Example for Rs 35,400 Basic:** Employees will receive an additional Rs 1,062 per month.
- **Example for Rs 50,000 Basic:** Monthly allowance will increase by Rs 1,500, moving from Rs 30,000 to Rs 31,500.

## Background and Verification

DA and DR are typically revised twice a year by the central government, with instalments taking effect from January 1 and July 1. This decision follows a previous 2-percentage-point revision announced in April 2026, which raised the allowance from 58% to 60% effective January 1, 2026.

To verify official implementation details, individuals should consult formal notifications and memoranda issued by the Ministry of Finance once published.
en_title: Cabinet Approves 3% DA Hike for Central Government Employees and Pensioners Ahead of Diwali
